key.name: capture-enabled
key.description: Store new clipboard text and images while the extension is enabled.

key.name: private-mode
key.description: Pause clipboard capture without disabling the extension.

key.name: history-limit
key.description: Maximum number of unpinned clipboard items to keep.

key.name: max-content-size
key.description: Largest clipboard text, in bytes, that will be stored.

key.name: max-image-size
key.description: Largest clipboard image, in bytes, that will be stored.

key.name: retention-days
key.description: Days to keep unpinned items. Zero keeps them until the history limit is reached.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Show the Cliporium button in the top panel.

key.name: toggle-popup
key.description: Shortcut that opens the clipboard popup. Unset by default.
